question: What does Qnami do? Summarise it in 200 words
answer:
Here’s a concise 200‑word summary of what Qnami does:

Qnami is a Swiss deep‑tech company, founded in 2017 at the University of Basel, that specializes in quantum sensing technologies based on nitrogen‑vacancy (NV) centers in diamond ([eetimes.eu](https://www.eetimes.eu/swiss-quantum-sensing-startup-raises-e3-6m/?utm_source=openai)). Their flagship product, the ProteusQ™, is the world’s first commercial scanning NV magnetometer—a quantum microscope that combines NV magnetometry with scanning probe microscopy to simultaneously map surface magnetic fields and topography at nanoscale resolution ([eetimes.eu](https://www.eetimes.eu/swiss-quantum-sensing-startup-raises-e3-6m/?utm_source=openai)).

Qnami develops proprietary diamond scanning probes called Quantilevers™, enabling ultra‑sensitive, non‑perturbative magnetic imaging under ambient conditions ([eetimes.eu](https://www.eetimes.eu/swiss-quantum-sensing-startup-raises-e3-6m/?utm_source=openai)). The ProteusQ system includes advanced electronics and software, offering automated operation, low drift, and scripting capabilities via Jupyter Notebook for flexible, high‑precision measurements ([qd-latam.com](https://www.qd-latam.com/site/en/products/application/patterned-magnetic-media/proteusq-quantum-microscope/?utm_source=openai)).

Their technology finds applications across materials science, spintronics, 2D materials, magnetic memories, antiferromagnets, nanomagnets, superconductors, current imaging, and biological systems ([qd-latam.com](https://www.qd-latam.com/site/en/products/application/patterned-magnetic-media/proteusq-quantum-microscope/?utm_source=openai)). Qnami has expanded its global reach through partnerships with distributors like HORIBA and Quantum Design, enabling broader access to its quantum sensing platforms in Europe, the Americas, and East Asia ([horiba.com](https://www.horiba.com/ind/scientific/resources/news/detail/news/7/2020/horiba-signs-strategic-cooperation-agreement-with-qnami-to-accelerate-scanning-nv-magnetometry-deve/?utm_source=openai)).

In summary, Qnami pioneers quantum‑enhanced microscopy tools that unlock unprecedented insights into magnetic phenomena at the atomic scale.
